Class GameController

java.lang.Object
com.example.sudoku.controller.GameController
All Implemented Interfaces:
IGameController, javafx.fxml.Initializable
public class GameController extends Object implements javafx.fxml.Initializable, IGameController
JavaFX controller for the Sudoku game view (game-view.fxml).

Responsibilities:

  • Builds the 6Ã—6 cell grid programmatically inside the FXML-injected GridPane, using 2Ã—3 block sub-grids.
  • Delegates input events to the named inner class GameController.CellInputHandler, which extends CellEventAdapter.
  • Keeps the visual state (CSS classes) in sync with the model after every user action.
  • Manages a live game timer via a Timeline.

UX/UI heuristics applied:

  1. Visibility of system status â€” real-time conflict highlights (red border) and a live timer.
  2. Match between system and real world â€” Spanish labels and familiar Sudoku vocabulary.
  3. User control and freedom â€” Undo and Restart actions.
  4. Error prevention â€” only digits 1â€“6 accepted; out-of-range keys are silently consumed.
  5. Recognition over recall â€” fixed clues visually distinct (cyan colour) from user entries.

    • handleNewGame

      public void handleNewGame()
      Starts a brand-new random puzzle, discarding the current game state. Resets the timer and clears any status messages. Wired to the "Nueva Partida" button in the FXML.

    • handleRestart

      public void handleRestart()
      Restarts the current puzzle from its initial state (fixed clues only). Resets the timer and clears all user-entered values. Wired to the "Reiniciar" button in the FXML.

    • handleHelp

      public void handleHelp()
      Provides a hint by automatically filling one empty cell with its correct solution value and highlighting it on the board. If a cell is currently selected and empty, the hint is placed there; otherwise a random empty cell is chosen. Wired to the "Ayuda" button in the FXML. Fills one empty cell automatically with the correct value and highlights it with the cell-hint style class.
